5264.title: Transmitting Islamic Values within the Family Ecosystem: A Thematic Quranic Exegesis
5264.authors: Abdul Malik Karim Amrullah, Siti Asiah, Muhyidin Azmi
5264.abstract: Rapid technological change and global value pluralism present challenges for Muslim families seeking to sustain religious and moral integrity across generations. This study examines the Qur’anic conception of the family’s role in transmitting and internalizing Islamic values. A qualitative library research approach employing thematic exegesis (tafsir maudhu‘i) was used to analyze four Qur’anic passages: Luqman (31:13–19), At-Tahrim (66:6), Ta-Ha (20:132), and Al-Baqarah (2:132). Primary sources comprised classical and contemporary Qur’anic commentaries, supplemented by literature on Islamic education and family psychology. 4930.title: Recentring Womanhood: The Quranic Method as a Moral Corrective to Feminist Social Disruption
4930.authors: Azreen Zuhairi, Nor Amni Bazilah Mohd Zain
4930.abstract: Contemporary feminist discourse has, in many contexts, shifted from its original pursuit of justice toward expressions of autonomy and resistance increasingly detached from transcendent moral foundations, contributing to social fragmentation, instability in family structures, and a crisis of moral identity. This study examines the Qur’an as a moral and spiritual corrective to such disruptions by advancing a faith-centred paradigm of womanhood rooted in divine guidance. The objective is to analyse how the Qur’anic method redefines empowerment beyond ideological contestation and restores balance, dignity, and ethical purpose. 14340.title: Dinamika Lafal Mawlā dalam Al-Qur’an: Analisis Kajian Semantik Ferdinand De Saussure
14340.authors: Mohammad Nabil Iklil Mubarok, Moh. Zahid
14340.journal: Ta’wiluna: Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur'an, Tafsir dan Pemikiran Islam
14340.abstract: This study traces the development of the meaning of the term mawlā from the pre-Qur'anic to the post-Qur'anic period, focusing on the diversity of meanings that appear in the texts of the Qur'an. As a key term in the Qur'an, mawlā has a broad range of meanings, from the vertical relationship between humans and God to the horizontal relationship between humans. This study aims to examine the dynamics of these meanings through an analysis of a number of Qur'anic verses, including Al-Taḥrīm (66:2), Al-Ḥajj (22:13), and others. 966.title: Taberî Rivâyetleri Bağlamında Hz. Hafsa’nın Tefsir İlmindeki Yeri
966.abstract: Hz. Hafsa Mekke’de dünyaya gelmiş olup Hz. Ömer’in kızı ve Hz. Peygamber’in hanımıdır. Kendisi hafız olup Medine’de Hz. Peygamber tarafından kadınlara okuma-yazma öğretimiyle görevlendirilmiştir. Vahyin başlangıç tarihinden ikinci asrın sonuna kadar kadınların Kur’ân’ı tefsir çabaları araştırma sebebi olmuştur. Tefsir ilmi bakımından Hz. Hafsa, ayetlerin doğrudan izahında ve kırâatlerin naklinde önemli katkılar sağlamıştır. Hz. 25355.title: Reconsidering the Role of the Father as Qawwam in Family Resilience: A Study of Thematic Exegesis of the Qur'an
25355.authors: Dudung Abdul Karim, M Darwis Hude, Muhammad Hariyadi
25355.abstract: This study examines the reconsideration of the father's role in strengthening family resilience through a Qur'anic thematic exegesis (tafsir mawdhu'i) perspective, positioned as a proactive scholarly response to the growing phenomenon of fatherlessness in Indonesia. Employing a qualitative methodology integrating tafsir mawdhu'i with descriptive-analytical and socio-psychological hermeneutic approaches, this study systematically traces Qur'anic verses related to paternal roles across authoritative classical and contemporary tafsir works (including Tafsir al-Thabari, Ibn Kathir, Al-Kasysyaf, and Al-Tahrir wa al-Tanwir). 26876.title: Kur’ân’da Aile İçi İletişimin İlke ve Sınırları: Tahrîm Sûresi’nin 1–4. Âyetleri Üzerine Bir İnceleme
26876.abstract: Bu çalışma, Tahrîm Sûresi’nin 1–4. âyetlerinin arka planında ortaya çıkan ailevi olaylar üzerinden Kur’ân’ın aile içi iletişimde hangi ilke ve sınırları koyduğunu ve bunların Hz. 910.title: Nüzûl Sebeplerinin Teaddüdü ve Müfessirlerin Tercih Kriterleri Bağlamında Hz. Peygamber'in Gizli Kalmasını İstediği Sırrın Mahiyeti Meselesi
910.abstract: Bu çalışmada Kur’ân-ı Kerîm’in mâhiyetini açıkça beyan etmediği bir kelimenin ifade ettiği anlama esbâb-ı nüzûl rivayetleri üzerinden ulaşmak amaçlanmaktadır. Bahsedilen amaç doğrultusunda, teaddüd eden esbâb-ı nüzûl rivayetleri arasında farklı tercihlerde bulunmada müfessirlerin gerekçeleri incelenmektedir. Kur’ân’ın açıkça beyan etmediği bir ibareden maksat, Tahrîm suresinin ilk ayetlerinde Hz. Peygamber’in gizli kalmasını istediği şey şeklinde geçen sırdır.
